meta.production_threshold_note: No explicit cosine acceptance threshold found in production candidate search; production ranks/returns top_k. Offline threshold analysis is exploratory only.

pose.reason: No reliable per-sample pose labels in synthetic manifest; pose not inferred from visual similarity.

robustness.method: Controlled in-memory crop degradations; embeddings computed via SFace.feature on resized 112x112 crop (proxy for degraded crop embedding, not production alignCrop path). Original retrieval benchmark uses alignCrop on original frames.
limitations: Degraded variants use resized-crop SFace.feature proxy, not full-frame alignCrop; absolute scores may differ from production path.
No enhanced TASK 15 outputs used as matching inputs.

threshold_analysis.production_threshold_note: No explicit cosine similarity acceptance threshold found in production candidate search; search ranks by cosine and returns top_k. 0.0 used as reporting baseline only.
threshold_analysis.change_reason: Offline-only exploratory analysis on small synthetic labeled set; no production threshold change justified without larger NOT_REVIEWED-cleared/real-world evidence.

limitations: Synthetic authorized dataset only; no real CCTV, no real identities.
Subject labels come from synthetic manifest only; no identity inferred from visual similarity.
Multi-subject/no-face/ambiguous frames excluded from identity pairs.
Small subject count (3 labeled subjects: SYN-A/SYN-B/SYN-C) limits ROC/AUC and threshold generality.
Cross-clip genuine pairs exist only where same synthetic label appears in multiple clips (SYN-A front/side).
Robustness uses resized-crop SFace.feature proxy; not identical to production alignCrop path.
